study type: Secondary analysis of a retrospective case-control study
exposure: Weight loss greater than 7% by day 3 of life
cohort: 286 term breastfeeding newborns born by cesarean delivery at a Level III maternity hospital in the Northeast region of the United States
finding: Newborns who lost more than 7% of their birth weight by day 3 had a significant decrease in exclusive breastfeeding rates by day 4 compared to those who lost less weight.
